name: Crystallis Veil
desc: Spawns Crystals from thin air to increase 25% Damage Resistance for 8 seconds. Also applies Clean Cut, increasing your Crit Chance by 15% for 6 seconds.
notes: Applies Clean Cut to caster, increasing caster's crit chance by 15% for 7 seconds.
Applies Crystallis Veil to caster, increasing caster's damage resistance by 25% for 9 seconds.

name: Cannon Fire
desc: Let off a blast of cannon fire from your conveniently nearby but hidden ship. Applies Cannon Wound, reducing your target's outgoing damage by 25% for 8 seconds.

name: Anagenesis
desc: Deliver a strike with your blade of flesh. Deals physical damage based on your Attack Power and Spell Power.

name: Consumed by the Abyss
desc: Unleash the twisted power of the Abyss onto your opponents. You enter your natural Fiendish state, granting you 25% Haste for 6 seconds while your foes are Consumed by the Abyss, lowering their Dodge by 25% for 6 seconds.

name: Arcane Sigil
desc: Inscribe an Arcane Sigil, significantly increasing your magical power. Your Arcane Sigil increases your Damage Dealt by 30% for 30 seconds, but the Overload of the spell increases your mana costs by 50% for 4 seconds and costs 40% of your current health.
notes: When Arcane Flux is in effect, consumes Astral Ascension and applies Corporeal Ascension, giving the caster 250% END, 60% Crit Chance, and a large rapid HoT based on mana when cast.

When Corporeal Ascension is in effect, consumes Corporeal Ascension and applies Astral Ascension, granting rapid mana regen, 60% more DoT damage, 20% Dodge, 5% Haste, and a small rapid HoT based on mana when cast.

name: Autoplay
desc: Enemies are as affected by your song as by any attack.

name: Always Open!
desc: As a Barber of the highest quality, you don’t know when to stop, so give it all you got and hit them where it hurts!… while you still have the mana. Has a higher than average chance to crit.

name: Fire Bolt
desc: Blast your opponents at long range with force bolts.
notes: Previously called "Force Bolt" and before "Auto Attack".
Old icon.

name: Fury Unleashed
desc: Deals damage and channels your fury into your greatsword. Gain Unstoppable Force, increasing your haste by 25% for 35 seconds. If your opponent is Ravaged, gain Fury Unleashed, increasing your outgoing damage by 50% for 10 seconds.

name: Strike Blades
desc: You wield Strike Blades. Manipulating with time allows you to attack incredibly fast, but sacrificing power.

name: Tsunami Strike
desc: Hits up to two enemies. slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.
notes: Deals 150% weapon damage.
Applies Tsunami Strike, reducing target haste by 50%.

name: Paralyzing Wind
desc: Hits up to two enemies for moderate damage, reducing all of their chances to hit by 50% for 6 seconds.

name: Auto Attack
desc: A basic attack, taught to all adventurers. Deals physical damage based on your Spell Power.

name: Actual Attack
desc: Using your mind, you reach out and cause pain to your foe… and boy, do they feel it!

name: Shattered Reality
desc: A powerful psychic burst AoE which will hit up to 2 foes. Applies Mental Weakness, reducing their damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

name: Forbidden Form
desc: A combat style used by those who have fallen to the dark side.

name: Auto Attack
desc: A rapid attack studied only by a reclusive few. Damage dealt is based on weapon damage.

name: Legacy Ablaze
desc: Draw upon the destructive power of dragons to blast 3 targets with a powerful attack. Your fury applies Draconic Rage for 8 seconds, increasing your Outgoing Physical Damage by 15%.

name: Auto Attack
desc: A strong attack known only to disciplined fighters. Damage dealt is based on weapon damage.

name: Arc Lightning
desc: Emit a burst of electrical energy that bounces to up to 4 targets, with each bounce dealing increased damage.

name: Twisted Viper
desc: Rip the dimensional fabric and attempt to partially invert your opponents, twisting their reality and reducing their outgoing damage for 15 seconds.

name: Stasis
desc: Smash the ground and create a 4th dimensional shockwave, trapping your opponent in the ebb and flow of time. Applies Warped, reducing up to 6 opponents' haste by 30% for 15 seconds.

name: Amas
desc: A basic attack, taught to all adventurers.

name: Amharach
desc: Surprise your opponent with a precisely aimed strike, dealing more damage the longer Keen has been active. Swiftly guard yourself after the strike, decreasing the damage you take by 40% for 6 seconds.
notes: Appies Amharach to the caster, reducing Incoming Damage by 40% for 6 seconds.
Translates to "Lucky" in Irish.

name: Soul Breaker
desc: You relentlessly beat at your foe's soul. Dealing high damage based on weapon attack, but with a longer cooldown.

name: Furious Strike
desc: A powerful sweeping attack taught to disciplined fighters.
notes: Previously called "Auto Attack".
Old icon.

name: Elemental Axe
desc: Strike your opponents from a further range with your Axe.

name: Strike of Order
desc: Attack with an enchanted weapon, dealing damage based on both attack power and spell power.

name: Axiom
desc: Cast a veil of magic that greatly heightens focus in yourself and up to 6 allies. Applies Clarity, increasing Haste by 30%, and Hit Chance and Critical Damage by 40% for 8 seconds.

name: Rapid Fire
desc: Nock an arrow, and loose it at faraway foes.

name: Psychic Assault
desc: Using your mind, you reach out and cause pain to your foe. This is the MindBreaker's basic attack.

name: Psychic Wave
desc: You send out waves of psychic energy dealing moderate damage to one or two enemies near you.

name: Strike'n Parry
desc: Perform a Counterthrust with your cutlass, reducing your target's outgoing damage by 40% for 1 second. Also applies Strike'n Parry, further reducing Outgoing Damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

name: Flintlock Barrage
desc: Fire your pistol at your target, wounding them and reducing their Damage Resistance by 30% for 10 seconds.

name: Blinding Light
desc: Deals damage to all enemies in range and applies Blinded, reducing enemy hit chance by 50% for 16 seconds.

name: Psychic Assault
desc: Assail two opponents with your mental attacks, clouding their minds and decreasing their crit chance by 25% for 4 seconds.

name: Auto Attack
desc: Double click a monster to start Auto Attacking it. This is a very unique attack that deals rapid, consistent damage based on your attack power instead of your weapon damage.

name: Grand Sweep
desc: Swing your sword in a large arc, crushing anything in its path. Enemies hit by your attack are critically stricken and become Crushed, weakening their damage output by 35% for 4 seconds.
notes: Deals 75% weapon damage.
This skill is guaranteed to crit.
Applies Crushed to enemy target for 4 seconds, reducing their damage output by 35%.

name: Slash
desc: You slash out at up to 3 targets with your extended Vampire claws, dealing 60% hybrid damage to each.

name: Necrotic Blade
desc: Strike your target with your Doom Blade. Applies Weakened, reducing your target's outgoing damage by 15% for 20 seconds

name: Decisive Strike
desc: A powerful strike. Applies Armor Shred to your target, reducing their Damage Resistance by 10% for 5 seconds.

name: Time Strike
desc: Deals damage based on your weapon damage.

name: Duel
desc: Advance your turn, damaging your opponent. Damage is increased by 50% per stack of Raise the Stakes you have.

name: Quick Stabs
desc: A rapid attack studied only by a reclusive few. You also carry a hidden blade and strike when your foe least expect it, dealing additional damage.

name: Moglin's Magical Strike
desc: A masterful spell that has been passed down by Moglins. Deals damage based on your spell power.

name: Auto Attack
desc: You already know how this one works.

name: Time Rift
desc: Deals damage to your target and applies Temporal Rift to you. Stacks to 4, lasts 30 seconds, and is used by your other abilities.

name: Time Rift Inversion
desc: Rollback time to heal yourself. If Temporal Rift is active, the amount healed is increased for each stack. Also applies Continuum, reducing all damage taken by 55% for 22 seconds. Always crits.

name: Time Rift Collapse
desc: If Temporal Rift is active, deal damage to your target based on the amount you've dealt in up to the past 10 seconds while it was active. Damage scales with each stack of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks.

name: Severed Rift
desc: Sever time for your target, placing a DoT effect on them that doubles in strength each time it ticks while reducing their outgoing damage by 25% for 10 seconds. Also applies Focus for 4 seconds, which forces your target to attack only you for the duration.

name: Mortification
desc: Unleash an ancient disease that damages your target and infects their cells with Necrosis, a DoT that lasts 5 seconds, stacks up to 25.

name: Bleeding Time
desc: Use your life essence to tap into the power of time. Deals damage and applies Chaos Rift to yourself for 30 seconds, stacks up to 4 and is used for your other abilities. You also enter an Eternal Frenzy, increasing your outgoing damage by 12% for 8 seconds, stacks up to 8. Also applies Passage of Time, which slowly damages you as long as you're in Frenzy, stacks to 100.

name: Temporal Reanimation
desc: Your mastery of time magic combined with your necromancy arts allow you to conjure undead in an instant. Summons an undead minion that deals increased damage the lower your health is. Applies Traveling Through Time, increasing your haste by 30%. Also applies Foreseeable Future, increasing your Crit Chance by 20%, stacks to 3. Both effects last 8 seconds.

name: ShadowScythe’s Past
desc: Tear open a portal in time and draw upon immense power from a past battle. Deals increased damage to your target for each stack of Necrosis on them. If Chaos Rift is active, your primary target takes damage over the next second based on the amount of damage you've dealt in the past 10 seconds while Chaos Rift was active. Damage scales with each stack of Chaos Rift and consumes those stacks. Applies Unleashing Doom, preventing Chaos Rift from being applied for 1 second.

name: ShadowScythe’s Future
desc: Relive the rebirth of your Empress. If you have stacks of Chaos Rift, they are consumed to apply Empress’s Awakening, healing you over 1 second. Also applies Debilitated, reducing your target's Hit Chance, Dodge, and Crit Chance by 20% for 12 seconds. Also applies Flow of Time, removing any stacks of Passage of Time you have while increasing your HoT and DoT for power by 20% for 12 seconds.

name: Quantum Rift
desc: Warp space-time to damage your target. Applies Temporal Rift for 30 seconds, which stacks up to 4 and is used by your other skills.

name: Quantum Fracture
desc: Fracture and fragment your foe's reality to harm their past and future selves. Inflicts Quantum Fracturing and Quantum Fragmenting, inflicting a DoT as well as reducing their Defense and Dodge by 30% for 10 seconds.

name: Quantum Shift
desc: Distort the timeline to alter combat capabilities. Applies Quantum Shift to you and your allies, increasing Crit Chance and Defense by 30% as well as Outgoing Physical and Outgoing Magical Damage by 10% for 10 seconds.
notes: At Rank 10, Quantum Shift applies stacks of Quantum Spiral to you for each friendly target affected, increasing your Crit Modifier and DoT damage by 10% for 23 seconds, stacks to 40 but cannot be refreshed.

name: Quantum Restructure
desc: Hack into reality for a brief moment and rebuild it in your favor. Applies Quantum Restructure to significantly reduce the amount of damage you take, while inflicting Quantum Rupture to significantly increase the amount of damage your target takes. Both effects last 2 seconds. Never misses or crits.
notes: Quantum Restructure increases the player's Dodge by 80% and decreases DoT In, All In, Phys In and Mag In by 20% for 2 seconds.
Quantum Rupture decreases the enemy's Dodge by 80% and increases DoT In, All In, Phys In and Mag In by 20% for 2 seconds.

name: Quantum Convergence
desc: Perceive and control the source of your powers as they were meant to be. Inflicts Quantum Convergence for 10 seconds, a heavy DoT. If Temporal Rift is active, consume it to deal damage to your target based on the damage you've dealt in the last 10 seconds while Temporal Rift was active.

name: Corrupted Sand Strike
desc: Deals damage based on your weapon damage. Each of your skills gets an additional benefit from hourglasses and corruption you equip in your consumables slot. Hourglasses and corruption can be obtained from the Hourglass Pet available from the Book of Lore.
notes: If Infinite Corruption is active, applies Infinity Rend for 40 seconds, a DoT that stacks to 15.
If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Corrupted Sand Strike.
At 5 stacks of Mad, the next Corrupted Sand Strike consumes these stacks and applies Eternal.
Eternal boosts your critical strike chance by 80% and reduces the damage you deal by 30%.

name: Sand Rift
desc: Deals damage to your target and applies Temporal Rift to you. Temporal Rift stacks 4 times, lasts 30 seconds and is used by your other abilities.
notes: If Hourglass of Transience is active, applies the following effects:
Flow if Transient is active, increasing enemy damage taken by 8% for 5 seconds, stacks to 3.
Ebb if Stabilize is active, applying an infinite growing DoT for 8 seconds.

name: Hourglass Inversion
desc: Reverses time to heal you. Heal is increased by stacks of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks.
notes: If Hourglass of Power is active, applies Power for 30 seconds, increasing damage, haste, crit chance, crit damage, hit chance, dodge chance and damage reduction by 10%.
If Hourglass of Transience is active, applies the following effect:
Incorporeal if either Transient or Ephemeral are in effect, consuming them and increasing Endurance and Haste by 50% for 10 seconds.
If Infinite Corruption is active, applies Hourglass Heal for 20 seconds, a Heal over Time.

name: Corruption Through Time
desc: Applies Corruption Through Time. Corruption Through Time increases all damage you do by 20% for 10 seconds. Doesn’t stack.
notes: If Entropic Corruption is active, applies the following effects:
Entropic Harm for 10 seconds, increasing damage taken by 150%.
Entropic Mana for 7 seconds, increasing haste by 30% and reducing mana costs by 50%.
Entropic Power for 4 seconds, increasing damage by 100%.
Focus for 3 seconds, forcing affected monsters to attack you.
If Foresee Corruption is active, applies the following effects:
Foresee for 150 seconds.
Using Foresee Corruption again replaces this effect with Seer for 20 seconds.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Seer with Change the Future.
Change the Future applies Focus to enemies, and decreases damage taken by 500%, and increases dodge chance, haste, hit chance, damage, and crit damage by 100% for 5 seconds.
If Hourglass of Paradise is active, applies the following effects (or removes them if they are currently active):
Welcome to Paradise, reducing damage taken by 60% and increasing haste by 50%. In addition, provides a Heal over Time that also regenerates mana. Lasts 2 hours.
Price of Paradise, reducing crit chance and outgoing damage by 30%. Lasts 2 hours.
If Hourglass of Transience is active, applies the following effects:
Transient for 10 seconds, a self DoT that increases in strength.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Transient with Ephemeral for 5 seconds, increasing dodge and damage by +50%.
If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Potential, increasing your Hit Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
If Timepiece of Inevitability is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Inevitable Corruption, increasing your outgoing damage and haste by 12% for 20 seconds.
Using the Timepiece of Inevitability while Inevitable Corruption is active applies Snap to your opponent, dealing significant damage to them after a short delay. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
If Timepiece of Pestilence is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Infectious Air, increasing the amount of damage the enemy takes by 20% for 10 seconds, stacking to 3 but is consumed by Temporal Collapse.
Your incoming damage is increased by 100% for 10 seconds.
Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.

name: Temporal Collapse
desc: Deals damage to your target based on the damage you've recently dealt while under the effects of Temporal Rift (in the past 10 seconds). Consumes Temporal Rift stacks.

name: Timeless Strike
desc: Deals damage based on weapon damage. Each of your skills gets an additional benefit from hourglasses you equip in your consumables slot. Hourglasses can be obtained from the hourglass pet available from the Book of Lore.
notes: If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Timeless Strike.
At 5 stacks of Mad, the next Timeless Strike consumes these stacks and applies Eternal.
Eternal boosts your critical strike chance by 80% and reduces the damage you deal by 30%.

name: Timeless Rift
desc: Deals damage to your target and applies Temporal Rift to you. Temporal Rift stacks 4 times, lasts 30 seconds and is used by your other abilities.

name: Hourglass Reversal
desc: Reverses time to heal you. Heal is increased by stacks of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks.
notes: If Hourglass of Power is active, applies Power for 30 seconds, increasing damage, haste, crit chance, crit damage, hit chance, dodge chance and damage reduction by 10%.
If Infinite Corruption is active, applies Hourglass Heal for 20 seconds, a Heal over Time.

Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.

name: Stretch Time
desc: Slow your target’s local time, reducing their Haste by 20% for 10 seconds. Also applies a stack of Temporal Rift.
notes: Deals 100% Weapon Damage.
Applies Stretch Time, reducing enemy Haste by 20%.

name: Compress Time
desc: Surround yourself or an ally in a bubble of compressed time. The target will heal, regain mana, have their Dodge increased by 25%, and Haste increased by 30% for 10 seconds.

name: Relive the Past
desc: If Temporal Rift is active, deal damage to your target based on the amount you've dealt in up to the past 10 seconds while it was active. Damage scales with each stack of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks. Also applies Relive The Past, which damages them over 8 seconds.

name: Stop Time
desc: Deals a large amount of damage to your target and locks them in time for 2 seconds. Also applies a stack of Temporal Rift.
notes: Deals 300% Weapon Damage.
Applies Stop Time, stunning the enemy for 2 seconds.

name: Timeless Strike
desc: Deals damage based on your weapon damage. Each of your skills gets an additional benefit from hourglasses you equip in your consumables slot. Hourglasses can be obtained from the Hourglass Pet available from the Book of Lore.
notes: If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Timeless Strike.
At 5 stacks of Mad, the next Timeless Strike consumes these stacks and applies Eternal.
Eternal boosts your critical strike chance by 80% and reduces the damage you deal by 30%.

name: Temporal Collapse
desc: If Temporal Rift is active, deal damage to your target based on the amount you've dealt in up to the past 10 seconds while it was active. Damage scales with each stack of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks

name: Chaos Rift Strike
desc: Deals damage to the target and applies Chaos Rift to you. Stacks to 4 and lasts 30 seconds.

name: Split Causality
desc: Chaos manipulates the flow of time for both you and your target. Applies a small or large HoT to yourself, and a small or large DoT to your target. The small effects last 8 seconds and the large effects last 2 seconds.
notes: Applies either Restore Time, a small HoT over 8 seconds or Mend Time, a large HoT over 2 seconds.
Applies either Time Bleed, a small DoT over 8 seconds or Time Hemorrhage, a large DoT over 2 seconds.

name: Time Collapse
desc: If Chaos Rift is active, deal damage to your target based on the amount you've dealt in up to the past 10 seconds while it was active. Damage scales with each stack of Chaos Rift and consumes those stacks.

name: Don’t Blink Twice
desc: Deals a large amount of damage to your target and applies Distorted Time to yourself, increasing your Haste by 20% for 15 seconds. Chaos empowers you, either applying Visceral Shift, which increases your outgoing physical damage by 75%, or Shiftburn, which increases your HoT and DoT power by 75%. Both effects last 8 seconds.
notes: Deals 250% damage.
Applies Distorted Time, increasing Haste by 20% for 15 seconds.
Applies either Visceral Shift, which increases physical damage done by 75% or Shiftburn, which increases the amount of DoT dealt and HoT healed by 75%.
